subject.title: [Bug]: Empty assistant delivery (footer-only, "— out" usage) on first turn after /new on Telegram-routed topic lane — 2026.5.27

question: Should maintainers keep this as the umbrella for the reset/session-allocation and Telegram delivery family, or split it into narrower canonical fix tracks before implementation?
rationale: The report is credible but spans core session persistence, cron/session resume behavior, Telegram delivery UX, diagnostics schema, and reset semantics; automation should not choose that product boundary alone.

options.title: Split Into Narrow Fix Tracks
options.body: Use this issue as evidence, but create or nominate separate canonical tracks for session allocation durability, missing transcript recovery, Telegram empty-delivery fallback, and reset/warm-restart UX.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical tracking item and require maintainers to sequence sub-fixes manually before any repair lane starts.

options.title: Supersede By Existing Issues
options.body: Close only after maintainers explicitly choose existing open issues such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/77871 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87327 as canonical homes and preserve this issue's evidence there.

recommendation.title: Split Into Narrow Fix Tracks
recommendation.body: Use this issue as evidence, but create or nominate separate canonical tracks for session allocation durability, missing transcript recovery, Telegram empty-delivery fallback, and reset/warm-restart UX.
